fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(51, 51, 51), rgb(193, 193, 193));
rect.title: The canary PCBA (canary step C1): the connector X1 for the canary link, with R1 between its two pins (nets CANARY_A, CANARY_B). X1 carries portName = canaryLink, portType = CanaryHeader and portTypeID = EE-PORT-0001 in the schematic, and CK-F1 compares them and its pins and nets with the pin map below.
